title: MIRADevice
description: Defines device identity, cryptographic registration, user association, and operational state for authenticated endpoints in the MIRA ecosystem.

device_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying the physical device or server instance.

user_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying the human user owning or operating this device, distinct from device identity.

device_name.description: User-friendly label (e.g., 'Pixel 9 Pro - Phone 1 Primary', 'Alienware Laptop - Windows MCP Server').

device_type.description: Architectural classification. Phone 1 is classified strictly as 'phone_primary'.

platform.description: Operating system environment hosting the client or server runtime.

status.description: Current network session and pairing state.

auth_token_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the device bearer secret/mTLS public certificate fingerprint.

capabilities.description: Set of authorized role tokens granted to this device.

ip_address.description: Last observed local or routable IP address for diagnostic telemetry.

last_heartbeat_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent keep-alive heartbeat message.

registered_at.description: Timestamp when device trust pairing was established.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last modification or status transition.

metadata.description: Device hardware attributes (e.g., screen dimensions, browser version, client OS build).
